candidates.title: Robot Hackathon: Harnessing Physical AI & Data
candidates.evidence:
Robot Hackathon: Harnessing Physical AI & Data 
Robotics Center of Silicon Valley
San Francisco, CA
Join **[Viam](https://www.linkedin.com/company/viaminc/)** and **[MongoDB](https://www.linkedin.com/company/mongodbinc/)** for a hands-on Robot Hackathon in San Francisco, October 29–30, 2026! Build with real robot arms, explore Physical AI, and compete to win a robot arm kit plus up to $10,000 in credits per winning team.

No robotics experience required—just bring your ideas and a laptop! 🚀

📍 Robotics Center of Silicon Valley, San Francisco
🔗 Register now: [https://luma.com/ta40197s](https://luma.com/ta40197s)

Space is limited, and approval is required. Sign up today!
